title: Build Array from Permutation
description:
[Source: LeetCode 1920]
Given a zero-based permutation nums (0-indexed), build an array ans of the same length where ans[i] = nums[nums[i]] for each 0 <= i < nums.length and return it in O(1) extra space.

Input Format:
First line: n
Second line: n space-separated permutation integers

Output Format:
Space-separated ans array
